entries.name: Named functions with fixed value parameters and return
entries.contract: Lowers declared named functions, fixed value arguments and explicit returns in the closed subset.

assertions: native PHP stdout equals generated Go stdout

limitations: No optional, typed, variadic or by-reference parameters
No closures or dynamic calls

entries.name: foreach over supported arrays
entries.contract: Iterates ordered GoHP arrays and binds value or key/value variables.

assertions: key and value iteration output matches native PHP
scalar foreach is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No by-reference iteration
Only supported array values

entries.name: Array literals
entries.contract: Lowers ordered arrays with supported integer and string keys and values.

assertions: mixed keys, nested reads and count output match
explicit maximum integer key behavior matches
automatic key after maximum integer fails explicitly

limitations: No array union or writes
No references
Boolean keys are rejected

entries.name: Array index reads
entries.contract: Reads supported array values by supported keys.

assertions: nested and keyed reads match fixture output
missing key runtime failure is not reported as a pass

limitations: Missing-key behavior is an explicit GoHP runtime failure, not a PHP warning-equivalence claim
No index writes

entries.name: Classes, no-argument construction and methods
entries.contract: Lowers classes with public scalar defaults, no-argument construction, property reads and methods in the closed subset.

assertions: method dispatch and public property read output match
missing property and wrong method arity are rejected

limitations: No inheritance, constructors, visibility, static members, traits or interfaces

entries.name: Binary +
entries.contract: Performs supported integral addition and rejects statically known invalid operands.

assertions: integer accumulation output matches
int64 overflow fails explicitly

limitations: No float promotion
Only limited numeric-string coercion

entries.name: Binary .
entries.contract: Concatenates supported values using GoHP runtime conversion.

assertions: target-version precedence output matches

limitations: Only supported value types
No complete PHP string conversion semantics

entries.name: Parentheses and target-specific +/. precedence
entries.contract: Parses the closed expression grammar and distinguishes PHP 7.4 and 8.3 precedence for addition and concatenation.

assertions: generated output equals the selected native PHP target
parenthesized integral addition output matches

limitations: Only +, . and parentheses are covered

entries.name: int64, string, bool and null literals
entries.contract: Represents the listed scalar literals in the closed subset.

assertions: bool and null concatenation output matches fixture

limitations: No floats, interpolation, complete casts or PHP type-juggling semantics

entries.name: count(array)
entries.contract: Supports one-argument, nonrecursive count for GoHP arrays only.

assertions: array count output matches
count on a scalar is rejected

limitations: No recursive or explicit second-argument mode
No PHP count behavior for arbitrary Countable values
Scalar rejection is not PHP warning/exception equivalence

entries.name: strlen
entries.contract: No lowering is provided.
limitations: Not supported

entries.name: array_map
entries.contract: No lowering is provided.
limitations: Callbacks and closures are unsupported

entries.name: json_encode
entries.contract: No lowering is provided.
limitations: Go JSON behavior must not be assumed PHP-equivalent

entries.name: Closures and callbacks
entries.contract: Closure syntax fails closed.

assertions: closure source is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No callback or dynamic-call support

entries.name: Array writes and references
entries.contract: Array element assignment and reference assignment fail closed.

assertions: array write and reference assignment are rejected

limitations: Copy-on-write and PHP reference semantics are not implemented

entries.name: include and require
entries.contract: Include syntax fails closed.

assertions: include source is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No autoloading, include paths or Composer resolver

entries.name: Floating-point literals and values
entries.contract: Float literals fail closed.

assertions: float literal source is rejected with a diagnostic code

limitations: No PHP floating-point or promotion semantics

entries.name: mysqli, PDO and SQLite extensions
entries.contract: No extension bindings or database operations are provided.
limitations: No credentials, DB writes or extension equivalence claim

entries.name: gohp CLI generation and artifact publication
entries.contract: Writes fresh generated Go and optional report artifacts without replacing existing or aliased destinations.

assertions: fresh output and report are written with consistent hashes
existing and aliased destinations are preserved
tested path-validation and generation failures leave no newly published artifacts

limitations: A successful generation report is not a PHP compatibility pass
No crash-atomic two-file publication; cleanup may fail on filesystem errors
Requires hard-link support and a private, non-concurrently-mutated workspace

entries.name: Statement-level PHP-to-Go source maps
entries.contract: Publishes final formatted Go line ranges mapped to PHP statement start lines.

assertions: nested statements, methods and formatted output map to expected PHP lines
unknown positions are omitted and failed generation leaks no map
a real generated Go panic frame resolves to the failing PHP statement

limitations: Not Source Map v3
No columns, multiple source files, debugger integration or PHP semantic guarantee
